target_statement: Distill the failed semilocal Hankel-to-Poisson route into the strongest reusable abstract operator theorems, with exact hypotheses, countermodels, positive converses, formal checks, and a literature-level novelty audit.
trust_model: Exact Hilbert-space or finite-dimensional proofs where stated, Lean kernel checks for algebraic cores, and primary-source literature attribution. Numerical examples are illustrations only.
first_unproved_edge: Determine which combination of projection-difference geometry, finite-codimensional constraints, one-sided Hankel compactness, and harmonic splitting can or cannot imply an A-relative Ward bound.
mask_or_node_class: Abstract separable Hilbert spaces first; the zeta specialization retains the minimal active local-factor mask only as an application, not as a hypothesis of the general theorems.
source_data_retained: Both Hardy directions, the signed projection defect, finite-rank moment constraints, collapsing old energy, and the distinction between ordinary traces and continuum trace anomalies.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Real or complex Hilbert-space vectors with signed self-adjoint defects; no componentwise positivity or absolute-value replacement.
normalization: D=P-U^*PU for an orthogonal projection P and unitary U; Ward quotient is |D(u,w)|^2/(D(u,u) h(w,w)) when D is positive on the chosen old direction and w is h-orthogonal to it.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: No height exponent is present. The essential feature is a positive old floor epsilon_n tending to zero while the cross term decays more slowly.
quantifier_order: First prove universal implications or construct a single universal countermodel; only afterward specialize to the zeta support family. No inference from finitely many zeta matrices to an operator theorem.
resolution_required: None for exact abstract theorems. Any anomaly regularization theorem must specify one common regulator and its removal order before block traces are separated.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.countermodel_rate: delta_n to zero, old floor delta_n^2, cross-square asymptotic delta_n, Ward quotient asymptotic 1/delta_n

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: The semilocal Hardy defect has one compact off-diagonal and an infinite-dimensional isometric reverse/Sonin channel; the explicit two-vector rotations provide positive old directions and harmonic complements.
downstream_socket: These theorems prune invalid proofs of relative HRW and identify exact Hardy alignment or a quantitative angle/observability estimate as the only positive socket. They do not themselves imply propagation, a strip, or RH.
parallel_open_siblings: common Abel or heat regularization of the four Hardy trace blocks
zeta-specific Hardy alignment or contamination cancellation
stable right inverse for moment-corrected shrinking collars
why_not_target_renamed: The negative theorems use only soft operator hypotheses and are strictly weaker than zeta HRW; the positive alignment lemma has an explicit additional factorization hypothesis whose zeta verification remains open.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Require an explicit model satisfying every advertised soft hypothesis while its Ward quotient diverges; otherwise do not call the hypothesis list insufficient.
fejer_falsifier: Not applicable to the universal operator results; for any claimed zeta specialization, retain both Hardy directions and test a smooth quasi-inner phase.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Not applicable to the abstract theorems; no conclusion about actual-prime arithmetic is licensed.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: Existing p=5 matrices may illustrate the theorem but cannot prove or refute its universal hypotheses.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any positive zeta corollary must add a genuinely arithmetic alignment or transversality premise; quasi-inner compactness alone is excluded.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Produces a reusable no-go/positive-converse toolkit and sharply specifies the new mathematics required by all signed Hankel-to-Ward proposals.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: If the proposed countermodel fails to realize an actual difference of projections or the alignment lemma needs hidden closed-range hypotheses, weaken or discard the claimed theorem before publication.
stop_rule: Stop promoting a result if it is only a standard theorem with renamed variables, if a trace manipulation crosses non-trace-class factors, if a finite-rank condition is silently treated as compactifying an essential channel, or if the positive converse merely assumes the Ward inequality in factorized notation.
